contexts.text: How great is the danger from profanation...
Unless it is received in freedom it is dangerous.
Such are most timid at the slightest danger, and most courageous when there is no danger.
How dangerous it is for a man to be in living consort with Spirits, unless he is in the good of faith.
With the peril of our souls We have brought our bread (). The peril of souls = the peril of the loss of faith, and therefore of spiritual life.
To speak with Spirits is now rarely granted, because it is dangerous. Explained. HH 292:2. EU 9:end. AE 1182:4. AE 1182:5. Explained.
It is dangerous to confirm anything by visions with those who are in falsities. Explained... This is the danger which is meant in .
No one is reformed in a state of misfortune... By states of misfortune are meant states of despair caused by danger; as in battles, shipwrecks, etc. Explained.
These things are not received, until after those who are meant by the dragon... have been cast out of the World of Spirits; because there would be danger if they were received before.

The internal of the Heaven from Christians was not fully formed... earlier than some time before the Last Judgment, and likewise after it... There was danger in collecting them into any Heaven before. Explained.
The descendants of Jacob... succumb in every danger... But the moment the state of danger is changed, they return into their nature...

1.2. The learned are not permitted to speak with Spirits, except at the peril of their lives... It is most dangerous for any learned person, who has been imbued with phantasies, to be able to speak with Spirits, or to be presented with any revelation.
For those who are not in the love of faith, it is as dangerous to come into the angelic Heaven as it is to go into flame. Explained.
Hence it may be known how dangerous it is to instruct others in evils, or to place stumbling blocks in anyone's way.
Under Charles XII, see this reference.
With peril of souls to bring bread = the difficulty and danger of procuring the truths of life from the Word.
